name: netease-floating-window
description: 网易云音乐悬浮窗 - 切歌时显示歌曲封面、歌名、歌手

scripts.build:smtc: dotnet build smtc-helper/smtc-helper.csproj -c Release && node -e "var fs=require('fs');var p=require('path');var s='smtc-helper/bin/Release';var d=fs.readdirSync(s)[0];var src=p.join(s,d);var dst='out/smtc-helper';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true})"
